## Summary
- add fail-closed unlocked-desktop Windows certification harness and self-hosted workflow
- add ignored UIA/input/pointer/clipboard and WGC picker interactive tests
- parse the PowerShell harness in hosted Windows CI without executing interactive claims
- update Windows authority docs and release blockers to match merged native CI evidence

## Claim discipline
Hosted Actions remain PASS_WINDOWS_NATIVE_CI only. The new workflow requires a self-hosted Windows runner labeled semwright-interactive. Unexecuted rows remain WINDOWS_INTERACTIVE_PENDING; external MCP filesystem mounts remain BLOCKED_PORTABLE_PATH_VIRTUALIZATION.

## Local validation
- cargo fmt --all -- --check
- git diff --check
- workflow YAML parse
- release-readiness.json parse

Heavy/native validation is delegated to GitHub Actions.

Pre-R16 maintainer preflight coordination (audit branch only; your worktree/branch is untouched):

1. Exact current-main SHA 241000c268d1bf1dc29d4e91a913097ac0d020cb is not green: Windows ARM64 job 108839165329 in run 36394993424 fails real_win32_fixture_exercises_uia_without_pixel_fallback at exact UIA inspection with StaleReference after BLOCKED_NONINTERACTIVE_OCCLUSION. x64 and both sealed-tool compatibility jobs pass. Please reconcile the fixture lifecycle/root cause; the occlusion message alone does not explain away the later failed assertion. https://github.com/seradotcom/semwright/actions/runs/36394993424/job/108839165329

2. In the reviewed run-interactive-certification.ps1 diff, Invoke-CargoRow and the secure_spawn_authority loop mark PASS from cargo exit code alone. A stale/misspelled test filter can select zero tests and still exit 0. Please require positive executed-test counts (and no ignored-only success), with a regression for a zero-selected run, before accepting PASS_WINDOWS_INTERACTIVE.

3. The workflow diff currently uses runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows], although the PR description requires a dedicated semwright-interactive label. Please retain explicit disposable-runner targeting and operator approval; do not dispatch interactive tests to a generic connected Windows machine.

I am correcting the review-bundle destructive-output behavior and reconciling root README/VERIFY/compatibility/changelog claims separately. R16 remains OPEN. No independent-review claim is being made.

body:
TIDELING adds an original 2.5D reef survival prototype with Blender-authored rigged assets, three growth stages, seven baseline species, swimming/dash, combo, predators and a three-minute run. A disabled Bluegold species is reserved for the cross-application proof.

The Blender driver previously lacked a game-ready export operation. `driver.blender.export.glb` now exports one explicit collection to a new GLB, validates collection dependencies, restores selection, refuses overwrite and returns a SHA-256 receipt. A dedicated hosted harness builds a new fish through the real broker and both drivers, transfers its artifact, enables its Godot resource and checks actual gameplay collisions.

Validation completed on earlier branch revisions: Blender semantic CI and native GLB adapter checks; Godot import, 13 rules assertions, keyboard/dash/collision acceptance and exported portable Linux pack smoke. Hosted lifecycle and cross-app runs are in progress. Current game remains a development prototype: final art/movement review, merged-SHA evidence and public release are not claimed. One visual review item remains open: central foliage competes with the swimming corridor.
